summary: An excerpt from a fiction book (Book 10, part 102) in which Lee-Daniel fires Joey Riel by phone, warning him that investors are ordering firings of most staff and that he should arrange money and transport before his roadhouse credit is cut off. Joey Riel reacts angrily, and Lee-Daniel asks him to keep the news quiet. The scene then shifts to a ceremonial perimeter walk of a newly wired 'Rez', where four crews with investors, Lee-Daniel and others use videoconferencing tablets to check network throughput while hiking the boundary on a fall day.
one_line: Lee-Daniel fires Joey Riel and other staff by phone, then the crew joins investors on a ceremonial perimeter walk of a newly networked Rez.
key_facts: Lee-Daniel tells Joey Riel he is fired because the order is coming down from the investors.
Lee-Daniel says the firings include Joey Riel, Elaine, all the customer service reps, and all but the two most senior antennamen and switchgirls.
Joey Riel had only just gotten his promotion, so Lee-Daniel gives him extra time to make calls and line up money before the roadhouse cuts off his credit.
Lee-Daniel tells Joey Riel he is going to need a ride.
Joey Riel responds with curses in three languages and sounds ready to burst.
Lee-Daniel asks Joey Riel to keep the news to himself, then snaps his phone shut.
Joey Riel calls his lawyer after the call.
The perimeter walk is described as a purely ceremonial event, initiated after the real post-install survey confirmed network integrity.
The group splits into four crews that walk the perimeter using ruggedized videoconferencing tablets with a two-by-two screen grid.
The data travels over the localnet and streams out over the uplinks to residents of other unwired sovereigns.
The investors walk with the Northeast party, along with Joey Riel, Meatloaf and Mermaid.
Mac stays on the bus, where he usually spends dusks and dawns out of the mosquitos' range.
Lee-Daniel takes the Southwest corner with Elaine, the hard-line girl from the gate, and Cobra.
Each crew walks counter-clockwise from the most-distant corner of the Rez, and a blinkenlight in each quadrant shows throughput, with five bars the goal.
The walk takes place on a nice early-fall day with bloody streaks of sunset on the horizon.
